gameName: The Elder Scrolls: Betrayal of the Second Era

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Elder Scrolls: Betrayal of the Second Era rulebook (Chip Theory Games)

steps.text: Choose a province (first campaign: Black Marsh; later the one your last session set); at least 3' x 4' of table
Its overland map to one side; its gazetteer set aside for reference
Dice and chip trays nearby; sort attribute, stat and overland tokens by type; pegs aside; all skill line tokens in the trainer bag
steps.note: Solo: remove duplicate copies of each skill line token

steps.text: Enemy chips by level into the bags: level 1/5 and level 10/20 (province-coded enemies only in their province)
steps.note: Jailbreak Introduction: only the level 1 enemies it lists

steps.text: Skill line reference sheets in the card tray
Shuffle the side quest cards
Peaceful and Conflict decks: draw 4 of the 10 general cards of each type and shuffle them with the province's 8, story side up
Delve deck: the province's delve cards without SP cards, shuffled with all general delve cards (plus the gazetteer's delve setup)
Shuffle the Common and Legendary item decks
Map tiles sorted by shape; clash tile and green entrance tile aside; delve tiles shuffled facedown per shape
XP and Day Dials in the chip holder: XP on {xp}; the Day Dial stays unset
Choose Apprentice, Adept or Expert difficulty
steps.note: Apprentice: rest removes 2 cooldown dice and heals 2 HP. Expert: 2 fatigue per extra engage and discard an item to rest

steps.text: Choose a party leader to keep the campaign journal
Pick a race sheet and chip: sheet beside your mat, chip in the art area
Health, Stamina and Magicka tokens from the race sheet; flip Health to its value; square stat tokens to the starting values
Combat skill line token in an open slot with the race's Combat dice
One more skill line with 2 level 1 dice (first game: Bow, Destruction Staff, One Hand and Shield or Two Handed)
Pegs: battle form of that line, the race's Cooldown stat, leftmost tenacity and Saved XP
Class sheet novice side up opposite the race sheet: Jailbreak decides the class options, otherwise open choice (permanent)
Continuing a campaign: set up adventurers as saved; full HP, no tenacity, dice back in their rows
First session: draw 3 Guild cards, read the snapshot and complexity (1-3) in the gazetteer, keep 1 faceup near the map; box the others
Read the quest's first step in the gazetteer; set aside its unit chips; party token and overland tokens on their start spaces
First game: play the Jailbreak Introduction encounter first, then return to setup
Begin the first day of the session
